The main takeaway from our work is that
anti-idiotype technology can provide a new approach to studying the molecular basis of antigen recognition by antibodies.
IG12, which mimics a hormone, can induce a population of anti-idiotypically related antibodies which share the hormone's binding specificity.

anti-idiotypically induced antibodies can be active in inhibiting biological functions of the original antigen, and therefore, anti-idiotypics can be used as surrogate antigens for the original antigen.
